profile.summary: mscdex is a senior-level JavaScript developer with deep expertise in Express.js backend development, particularly in router middleware design and Node.js runtime compatibility. Their contributions demonstrate strong debugging skills, proactive test maintenance, and a focus on optimizing backend performance. The developer shows high confidence in handling complex Express internals, such as request lifecycle control and HTTP method handling, while also ensuring backward compatibility with Node.js version changes. All contributions are backend-focused, with no evidence of frontend or full-stack experience.
